# Trimble Maps Road Speeds Service

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Road Speeds Service (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Trimble Maps API key. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps API key.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Maps API key.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.trimblemaps.com/`.

## RoadSpeeds

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/roadspeed/v1/speed` | `reference` | Get custom road speeds or default speeds by jurisdiction. | jurisdiction (query); abbreviationType (query); vehicleType (query); region (query); defaultSpeeds (query); units (query) |
| `POST` | `/roadspeed/v1/speed` | `reference` | Set custom road speeds by road type and jurisdiction. | body: application/*+json, application/json, application/json-patch+json, text/json |
